budget_rollover_shape.name: budget_rollover_shape
budget_rollover_shape.value: ("budget"."rollover" AND "budget"."rollover_from" IS NOT NULL AND "budget"."category_id" IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT "budget"."rollover" AND "budget"."rollover_from" IS NULL)

recurring_rule_transfer_shape.name: recurring_rule_transfer_shape
recurring_rule_transfer_shape.value:
("recurring_rule"."type" = 'transfer' AND "recurring_rule"."to_wallet_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recurring_rule"."to_wallet_id" <> "recurring_rule"."wallet_id" AND "recurring_rule"."category_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("recurring_rule"."type" <> 'transfer' AND "recurring_rule"."to_wallet_id" IS NULL)

transaction_transfer_shape.name: transaction_transfer_shape
transaction_transfer_shape.value:
("transaction"."type" = 'transfer' AND "transaction"."to_wallet_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transaction"."to_wallet_id" <> "transaction"."wallet_id" AND "transaction"."category_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("transaction"."type" <> 'transfer' AND "transaction"."to_wallet_id" IS NULL)
